annotations.title: Check likeness clearance for a name

description: Start here when anyone asks whether a real person's name, image or likeness can be used — in an ad, a campaign, generated media or a contract. Checks whether that person has publicly declared how their likeness may be used on WEIR AI. Required: name (full name, at least 3 characters). Returns status blocked, protect, earn (licensable), open, or no_public_declaration, plus terms_url when a public license matches. Private licenses always return no_public_declaration, so this never reveals whether someone is a member. no_public_declaration is not permission. To browse who is licensable rather than check one named person, use search_catalog. [Public, no account needed]
name: check_identity
title: Check likeness clearance for a name
